source.original_source: Original F124-AE graph builder and deterministic first-admissible public-reference test, with only new phase cohorts and separate source salt via new seed. Identical long, dense and relaxed families.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Anchor10 causes 13-15-hop false positives by removing score discrimination. A **public exact-key continuity contrast**, calculated for the original same hard 7+9 cell ranking, may distinguish long-path positives from negatives without altering state capacity or source-blind weight inference.
Yggdrasil.baseline: Original qualified AD anchor10 at gamma=.25, penalty=.25; T raw logit and 7 active/9 retained hard decisions immutable. Calculate exact-key terminal consistency from original frozen Z code; same node/cell selection, no route oracle or hidden reference. Score AD anchor10 - lambda*(soft_ratio-hard_ratio). For lambda=0 bitwise equal AD. Extra continuity count per existing cell is recorded; cannot claim unchanged bytes or matched memory vs AD.
Yggdrasil.fit_rule: Maximize correct 48 paired new FIT comparisons; ties prefer 0 then smaller lambda. No parameter changes after independent DEV.

Wingless.hypothesis: A source-blind terminal **contrastive confidence margin** between the original one packed target score and strongest non-target terminal state can suppress false positives without indiscriminately raising or lowering all logits.
Wingless.baseline: Exact original AA source-only one state/node, 12-bit checksum, unchanged learned weights and hard per-node rank. Compute target_value and best_nontarget_value using the same original terminal states at last hop. If nontarget unavailable, contrast=0. Score original_logit + beta*clip((target_value-best_other)/len(roles),-1,1). beta0 must produce exactly original score.
Wingless.fit_rule: Maximize 48 new FIT paired correctness, tie prefer 0 and lower beta; never retune after DEV
